correctness.rationale: The assigned RESULT.md models each permitted word as a path of m=n-2 edges in the six-arc restricted binary order-2 de Bruijn graph. Independently checked the vertex balance equations, connected Euler-trail support in the balanced and central endpoint families and forced outer-edge shifts covering all ordered endpoint imbalances. The geometric sums H0=(1+z^3)/D, Hc=z(1+z)/D and (1+4z+2z^2)H0+(2+4z)Hc yield exactly (1+6z+8z^2+5z^3+4z^4+2z^5)/D with D=(1-z^2)(1-z^3)(1-z^4). Sympy exact partial fractions give leading 13m^2/24+9m/4 and minimal period 12 from nonzero cubic/fourth-root terms. Fresh independent literal constrained-word counts n=2..16 and complete edge-flow-versus-walk comparisons m=0..9 agree. These finite checks corroborate rather than prove all n; Eulerian support and the formal series establish the infinite result.
